provenance.question: does a theta shared across several training pairs transfer to held-out pairs better than a theta fitted on one pair?
provenance.formulation: block LP: one shared theta, per-pair (f_p, g_p), per-pair edge set F_p, objective is the mean of the per-pair regrets
provenance.edge_sets: F_p is the edge set each single-pair loop finished with, NOT regenerated in the joint LP, so theta_multi solves a RESTRICTED master and its regret is a lower bound on the joint optimum
provenance.solver: scipy HiGHS on the assembled sparse LP (one solve, no constraint generation)
provenance.comparison: theta_single (fitted on pair 1) vs theta_multi (shared over all P), both evaluated on the same held-out test pairs
